title: 第11章 豪门千金（11）-《反派BOSS有毒》
content:
第(1/3)页

    管理老师朝着苏衣衣看去，果然看到苏衣衣额头上红了，皱着眉问：“苏衣衣，是谁推的你？”

    苏衣衣缩了缩，余光瞄了眼时笙，随后摇头，“没事，我自己摔的。”

    这么欲盖弥彰的行为老师哪里看不出来，“不许撒谎，是不是她推的你？”

    更何况这苏衣衣她平日里也遇见过，挺好的一个女孩，对谁都和和气气的。

    倒是旁边这个女孩，平时也是独来独往，有点不好相处的样子。她还看到有豪车来接她，回来身上的衣服还都换了，这种女生她见多了。

    想到此，老师心底的天平不免偏向了苏衣衣。

    “不是……”苏衣衣还欲解释。

    “衣衣，你替她遮掩什么，老师就是她，我和夏柠可以作证。”

    夏柠迟疑了下，见时笙那副浑然不在意的模样，心底有些怨气，也跟着点了点头。

    “你叫什么名字？”老师看向时笙，摆明了是已经相信了安安和苏衣衣。

    “许乘月。”时笙似笑非笑的盯着苏衣衣。

    那眼神盯得苏衣衣很不自在，但是一想到她绝对没有证据，不免又定了定心神。

    “许乘月同学，和同学起了争执，导致同学受伤，罚你扫一周操场，有意见吗？”

    “老师就听信他们的一面之词？”时笙微微挑眉，只问苏衣衣她们就定罪了，这老师明摆着偏帮苏衣衣。

    老师脸色黑了一瞬，她本来只是想小小惩罚一下，这死丫头竟然不领情。

    “有两位同学亲眼所见，你还有什么好狡辩的？身为学生就该有学生样，别整天想着有的没的，这个社会复杂得很，你以为你那点小心思真的能让你飞上枝头变凤凰？”

    时笙直接冷了脸，“老师这话是什么意思？”

    “你自己做过什么你自己不知道，还有脸问。”安安讥讽的接话。

    苏衣衣满脸的委屈，眼角却全是得意。

    就算不是真的，可说的人多了，谁还管你是不是真的。

    此时门外已经有不少人围观，听到这话纷纷低声议论。
    第(1/3)页

Page (1/3)

The management teacher looked at Su Yiyi and saw that Su Yiyi's forehead was red. He frowned and asked, "Su Yiyi, who pushed you?"

Su Yiyi shrank, glanced at Shi Sheng from the corner of her eye, and then shook her head, "It's okay, I fell myself."

How could the teacher not see such a cover-up behavior? "Don't lie. Did she push you?"

What's more, she has met Su Yiyi in her daily life. She is a very nice girl who is kind to everyone.

The girl next to her, on the other hand, usually keeps to herself and is a bit difficult to get along with.She also saw a luxury car coming to pick her up, and she had changed all her clothes when she came back. She had seen this kind of girl many times.

Thinking of this, the balance in the teacher's heart inevitably tilted towards Su Yiyi.

"No..." Su Yiyi still wanted to explain.

"Yiyi, what are you covering up for her? She is the teacher. Xia Ning and I can testify."

Xia Ning hesitated for a moment. Seeing Shi Sheng's nonchalant look, she felt a little resentful in her heart and nodded.

"What's your name?" The teacher looked at Shi Sheng, making it clear that he believed An An and Su Yiyi.

"Xu Chengyue." Shi Sheng stared at Su Yiyi with a half-smile.

That look in her eyes made Su Yiyi very uncomfortable, but when she thought that she had absolutely no evidence, she couldn't help but calm down.

"Classmate Xu Chengyue got into an argument with a classmate, which resulted in the classmate being injured. I will punish you by sweeping the playground for a week. Do you have any objections?"

"Teacher, just believe their one-sided story?" Shi Sheng raised his eyebrows slightly, and they were convicted just by asking Su Yiyi. This teacher was obviously biased towards Su Yiyi.

The teacher's face turned dark for a moment. She originally just wanted to give her a small punishment, but this damn girl didn't appreciate it.

"Two classmates have seen it with their own eyes. What else do you have to argue with? As a student, you should behave like a student. Don't think about what you have and what you don't have all day long. This society is very complicated. Do you think your little thoughts can really make you fly up a branch and become a phoenix?"

Shi Sheng’s face turned cold, “What do you mean, teacher?”

"You don't know what you have done, and you still have the nerve to ask." An An answered sarcastically.

Su Yiyi’s face was full of grievance, but the corners of her eyes were full of pride.

Even if it’s not true, there are so many people saying it, who cares whether it’s true or not.

At this time, there were many people watching outside the door, and they all whispered when they heard this.
